title: Elite Baal cult tied to the Epstein material

tellings.quote: because it's apparent that the some of the elite, some of our ruling elite are obsessed with with Bal.

plain: Some of America's ruling elite are obsessed with Baal, the ancient god whom the Bible condemns, according to the researcher and filmmaker Tim Alberino. He tells Michels that this shows up in the Epstein files, the records made public about the financier and sex offender Jeffrey Epstein. He gives it as his own reading of that material and quotes nothing from it, though if it were true, it would mean an old cult was alive among the powerful.
